Create a fictional request, review its changes and test what happens when an operation is repeated. A personal prototype with a contract and runnable .NET reference.

Local demo · Fictional data · No submissions

The interface reproduces the .NET API contract in this tab’s memory. It does not connect to your company, grant access or send approvals or emails. Reloading clears everything.

    From browser to integration

    The repository includes an ASP.NET Core 10 API, domain checks and HTTP checks using the same scenarios as the demo. It also includes a guide to connect a Power Automate flow with approval and error handling.

    .NET source and executionHTTP contractPower Automate guideShared scenarios

    The API is a local reference without authentication or durable storage. Power Automate is a configuration guide, not a deployed flow. A real environment requires permissions, identity, persistence and the licences needed by its connectors.

    Cookies and privacy

    What we store

    The at_consent cookie remembers your choice for six months. Optional settings are stored locally for the same period. You can withdraw permission here: those settings will be deleted. Controls still work during your visit if you choose necessary only. If you enable the demo’s optional AI, the browser may store model files; delete them from the demo itself. Questions are not stored.

    When you submit the form, your name, email, subject and message pass through Formspree to reach alejandro.dev.sergio@outlook.com. They are used to respond to your enquiry. The provider processes and stores details under its privacy policy. Do not include passwords or sensitive information.
